736:t_1:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「...I cannot believe it... $$サクリファイ$$ was slain by Earthlings...」

736:t_1:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I am sorry, $$ドクトリン$$... By the time I arrived, it was already over.」

736:t_1:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「But how!? The $$御使い$$s are eternal beings!」

736:t_1:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Probably because $$サクリファイ$$ rejected her own eternity. That is the only explanation I can think of.」

736:t_1:8.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「She denied her own existence as an $$御使い$$... Given how she was consumed by sorrow, that is plausible.」

736:t_1:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Still, we were fortunate to recover four $$スフィア$$s from $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.」

736:t_1:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Though the man himself escaped...」

736:t_1:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「It serves him right. We've located all the $$スフィア$$s, so we don't need him anymore anyway.」

736:t_1:12.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We can leave him alone. All that remains is to reclaim the four $$スフィア$$s the Earthlings hold.」

736:t_1:13.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Without the $$いがみ合う双子$$ as its core, $$至高神ソル$$ cannot be reborn.」

736:t_1:14.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Though now that we have established a way to stop the universe's great collapse, we no longer need to rush the rebirth ritual.」

736:t_1:15.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「The key to that... is the Earthlings, right?」

736:t_1:16.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「They are on their way here.」

736:t_1:17.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Perfect timing. Now we can stop the universe's great collapse too.」

736:t_1:18.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The extermination of the evil species has already begun in each universe. We will finish the job.」

736:t_1:19.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then I will handle the Earthlings... $c.」

736:t_1:20.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I had high hopes for them. I want them to pay for at least one ten-thousandth of the disappointment they caused me.」

736:t_1:21.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Then I permit you to use the eight $$スフィア$$s. We will proceed with adjustments to $$プロディキウム$$.」

736:t_1:22.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Once all twelve $$スフィア$$s are gathered, we will perform the rebirth ritual to ensure the universe's salvation.」

736:t_1:23.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I will leave that to you, $$ドクトリン$$.」

736:t_1:24.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
(Now, $c... Let me see your final struggle.)

736:t_1:31.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The fighting that has gone on since the $$多元戦争$$... All of it will soon be over...」

736:t_1:32.en:
$$シン$$
「$$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$ in the $$多元戦争$$... Dimension General $$ガイオウ$$ in the $$破界事変$$ and $$再世戦争$$... All those battles led to the $$御使い$$s.」

736:t_1:33.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I never imagined it would involve every parallel world.」

736:t_1:34.en:
$$シン$$
「...This may not be the time to say it, but...」

736:t_1:37.en:
$$シン$$
「It let me meet you and everyone else. That's why.」

736:t_1:39.en:
$$アスラン$$
「We can smile together like this now because of all the experiences we had in the multiverse.」

736:t_1:40.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「The fact that I am here like this is thanks to that too.」

736:t_1:41.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「If the $$大時空震動$$ hadn't happened, I might never have started dating $$シン$$.」

736:t_1:45.en:
$$シン$$
「Even you are joining in, $$カミーユ$$ and $$キラ$$!?」

736:t_1:46.en:
$$アスラン$$
「But we overcame all those 'what ifs,' and now we're here together.」

736:t_1:47.en:
$$ファ$$
「After all those meetings and partings, our hearts are united now.」

736:t_1:48.en:
$$フォウ$$
「A lot of sad things happened, but even more happy things happened.」

736:t_1:49.en:
$$カツ$$
「To keep that from ending, we absolutely have to win the next battle.」

736:t_1:50.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If we lose, everything ends... We won't just die. Everything in the world... in the universe will vanish.」

736:t_1:51.en:
$$キラ$$
「Let's fight, carrying the feelings and strength of every living being.」

736:t_1:53.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Will everything be over if we defeat the $$御使い$$s...?」

736:t_1:54.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Even if we get rid of them, it's the end anyway if we can't stop the universe's great collapse.」

736:t_1:55.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So peace won't come until we solve both problems.」

736:t_1:56.en:
$$マリー$$
「But even if that day comes...」

736:t_1:57.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Someone will probably appear someday to break that peace again.」

736:t_1:58.en:
$$カトル$$
「But someone will surely appear to fight them too.」

736:t_1:59.en:
$$トロワ$$
「If no one does, we'll do it ourselves.」

736:t_1:60.en:
$$五飛$$
「I dedicated my life to laying the foundation for peace long ago.」

736:t_1:61.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Yeah! That's a soldier's duty too!」

736:t_1:62.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Exactly. That is also the path I have found.」

736:t_1:63.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「It is our role to fight the enemies who threaten peace...」

736:t_1:64.en:
$$ノイン$$
「And $$リリーナ$$ and the others will protect the peace we win.」

736:t_1:65.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「For that, we must triumph over the $$御使い$$s and the universe's great collapse.」

736:t_1:67.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$ヒイロ$$... What will you do when the fighting ends?」

736:t_1:70.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What do you plan to do?」

736:t_1:71.en:
$$刹那$$
「If we can make it through this battle...」

736:t_1:72.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm thinking of visiting the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ homeworld.」

736:t_1:73.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What are you going there for?」

736:t_1:74.en:
$$刹那$$
「I want to reaffirm what we gained in this battle... the ability to understand each other. I'll start with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

736:t_1:75.en:
$$刹那$$
「And if we truly grasped the truth of the universe, I want to use it to create something new.」

736:t_1:76.en:
$$刹那$$
「Even if it takes years... or decades.」

736:t_1:77.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「All right. ...But make sure you come back.」

736:t_1:78.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I want to know what new thing you create too.」

736:t_1:80.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Will everything be over if we defeat the $$御使い$$s...?」

736:t_1:81.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Even if we get rid of them, it's the end anyway if we can't stop the universe's great collapse.」

736:t_1:82.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So peace won't come until we solve both problems.」

736:t_1:83.en:
$$マリー$$
「But even if that day comes...」

736:t_1:84.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Someone will probably appear someday to break that peace again.」

736:t_1:85.en:
$$カトル$$
「But someone will surely appear to fight them too.」
